21 / 4 - 1933

Translation of official despatch, No. 5108 from
the President of the First Shanghai Special
District Court to the Commissioner of the
Shanghai Municipal Police dated April 15, 1933.

I am in receipt of a letter from the
Public Safety Bureau of the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai to the effect that as permission
for registration has been granted to the Chung Hwa
Weekly (中華週報) after its reorganization, the
ban placed on the publication has been lifted.

In consequence of this, I send you this
letter with a request that the restriction placed
on this journal be removed.

(Seal) Kuo Yuan Kwan,
President,
First Shanghai Special District
Court.

Reg.
Please prepare formal
acknowledgment to be
signed by the
Commissioner of Police.
JMS
APR. 21 1933

File No. __________
Special Branch SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
Date April 29, 1932
V. D 3338.
（印：29.4.32）

Subject (in full) Letter from the 1st. Special District Court (Shanghai) re
the Chung Hwa Weekly (中華週報).

Made by D.S.I. Moore. Forwarded by C.S.I. J.W. Price.

With reference to the attached letter from the President, 1st.
Shanghai Special District Court requesting that action be taken
against the "Chung Hwa Weekly" (中華週報) (China Weekly Herald),
on the grounds that certain articles in the 16th. issue of this
paper dated February 20, 1932, are anti-Government, enquiries
show the offices of this paper to be situated on the 2nd. floor of
No.19, Museum Road, from where a copy of the 16th. issue of the
publication, referred to in the letter from the S.S.D. Court, was
obtained.

A translation of the alleged reactionary articles have been
been made, and from perusal appear to be ordinary criticism such
as appears regularly in daily Chinese newspapers. The Municipal
Advocate's department has been consulted as to whether action
by the Shanghai Municipal Police would be warranted, and an
opinion by Mr. P.P.Y. Ru is that no offence has been committed.

The opinion of Mr. Ru and translations are submitted
attached.

（签名：D.S.I.）
D.S.I.
Officer I/c Special Branch.

（批：Reg: Please acknowledge letter stating matter is receiving attention. J.W.P. 29.4.'32.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

档案号 ___
特务处 上海公共租界工部局警务处
C. & S. B. 登记处。
日期 1932年4月29日
V. D 3338。
（印：1932年4月29日）

主题（全称） 上海第一特区地方法院关于《中华周报》之来函。

由警司摩尔（D.S.I. Moore）呈报。经首席警司 J.W. Price 转呈。

兹参照所附上海第一特区地方法院院长来函，该函要求对《中华周报》（China Weekly Herald）采取行动，理由是该校1932年2月20日出版的第16期中某些文章具有反政府性质。经查，该报社办事处位于博物院路19号二楼，并从该处获取了上海特区地方法院来函中所提及的第16期出版物样本。

据称具有反动性质的文章已译出，经阅看，似属中国日报中常见的普通批评性言论。已就上海公共租界工部局警务处是否有理由采取行动一事咨询市公诉人办公室，P.P.Y. Ru 先生的意见是未构成犯罪。

Ru 先生的意见及译文随函附上。

（签名：D.S.I.）
警司
特务处主管警官。

（批注：登记处：请回复信函，说明此事正在处理中。 J.W.P. 1932年4月29日。）

Extracts from the "China Weekly Herald", Issue No. 16,
dated February 20, 1932. (Address: 19 Museum Road).

EXPOSURE OF WEAK POINTS DURING THE HOSTILITIES.

Political organization and organized social
life are the sole differences between a modern nation and
an ancient tribe. Unification is essential to the existence
of a nation in this modern age.

During the recent Shanghai hostilities, the 19th
Route Army repeatedly defeated a stronger foe and its
bravery aroused appreciation in the hearts of all our country-
men. However, we admit that despite the military success
during the hostilities, the Government as a whole has
disclosed the following weak points in its struggle against
foreign aggression:-

(1) It is excusable for the Chinese forces to take a
defensive stand when the Japanese soldiers first
attacked Chapei, because Chinese gunfire and advance
towards the Settlement, which adjoins Chapei, will
cause misunderstandings with the Powers. At present
the battlefield extends from Chapei to Woosung. Wen-
tsao-pang and Kiangwan are Chinese territory but are
deserted. There will be no harm to the Settlement
if big guns are used. Why have not the Chinese
troops taken the offensive? The Japanese are daily
sending reinforcements and if the war be prolonged,
a deadlock will be reached. Why not take the offensive
and end the war quickly? How is it that the Central
Government sent so small reinforcements? How is it
that the Chinese troops have to wait for the Japanese
to attack? We cannot understand this.

(2) More than ten days have elapsed since the outbreak
of hostilities, yet the policy of the Central Government
is still undisclosed. We appreciate the Government's

摘自1932年2月20日出版的《字林西报周刊》（China Weekly Herald）第16期。（地址：博物院路19号）。

战事期间暴露之弱点。

政治组织与有组织的社会生活是现代国家与古代部落之间的唯一区别。统一对于现代国家的生存至关重要。

在近期的上海战事中，第十九路军屡次击败强敌，其英勇行为激起了全体同胞心中的赞赏。然而，我们承认，尽管在战事中取得了军事胜利，但政府在整个抗击外国侵略的过程中暴露出以下弱点：-

(1) 当日军首次进攻闸北时，中国军队采取守势是可以理解的，因为中国军队的炮火及向与闸北相邻的租界推进，会引起列强的误解。目前战场已从闸北延伸至吴淞。蕴藻浜和江湾虽是中国领土，但已被遗弃。如果使用重炮，对租界并无损害。为何中国军队不采取攻势？日军每日都在增援，如果战争 prolonged（延长），将陷入僵局。为何不采取攻势以迅速结束战争？中央政府为何只派遣如此少量的增援部队？为何中国军队必须等待日军进攻？对此我们无法理解。

(2) 战事爆发已十余日，但中央政府的政策仍未公开。我们赞赏政府

determination to offer a long resistance, but it
is more important for the Government to act quickly.
The Foreign Affairs Committee has held many
conferences but no decision has been reached to
clear our doubts. For the last ten days the
Government has neither rendered sufficient resistance
nor has it done anything for peace.

(3) The resistance offered by the 19th Route Army against
Japanese invasion has won moral and material support
from the people throughout the country. But what are
the aspirations of our people in the present war?
No movement can be successful without an object. We
are unable to understand the inconstant attitude
of the various influential bodies in Shanghai in
making strong suggestions at one moment and working
for peace in another.

(4) With the enemy troops in our territory, our people
are still not united and the members of the Party
hold conflicting views. Hu Han Min and other members
of the Central Executive Committee in Shanghai are
dissatisfied with the Government. These members of
the Central Executive Committee have authority to
pass final decision on the policies of the nation.
How is it that they have not returned to Nanking to
exercise their power, but instead have scattered to
various places and are broadcasting irresponsible
speeches?

The Japanese aggression is well organized. For instance,
the Japanese Cabinet meetings, troops movements, diplomatic
and military affairs, the Government and the people, are
all unified. Whereas China is not organized at all, lacking
and lack unification. We do not wish to degrade ourselves
but we cannot help disclosing these defects in order to
warn our countrymen and to encourage the,

长期抵抗的决心，但政府迅速行动更为重要。外交委员会已举行多次会议，但尚未作出决定以消除我们的疑虑。在过去十天里，政府既未进行充分抵抗，也未为和平做任何事情。

(3) 第十九路军抵抗日本入侵的行为赢得了全国人民的道义和物质支持。但是，我国人民在当前战争中的诉求是什么？没有目标，任何运动都无法成功。我们无法理解上海各 influential bodies（有影响力的团体）态度反复无常，一时提出强烈建议，一时又致力于和平。

(4) 敌军已进入我国领土，我国人民仍不团结，党内成员意见相左。胡汉民及其他在上海的中央执行委员会委员对政府不满。这些中央执行委员会委员有权对国家政策作出最终决定。他们为何不回南京行使权力，反而分散到各地，发表不负责任的言论？

日本的侵略是有组织的。例如，日本内阁会议、军队调动、外交和军事事务、政府和人民，都是统一的。而中国则毫无组织，缺乏且缺少统一。我们不愿贬低自己，但不得不揭露这些缺陷，以警示同胞并鼓励

pages.en:
- 3 -

INEXPLICABLE POLITICAL INCONGRUITIES.

The Japanese allegation that China is not an organized nation is without doubt a base insult to our country. However, if we read our newspapers carefully, the surprising number of inexplicable political incongruities will become apparent. For example, the Minister of Finance desiring to prohibit all provincial authorities from holding national revenues, sends a circular telegram to that effect and in reply receives the avowed support from several provincial authorities. Let us ask what the policy of this administration means?

Another example:- Soldiers are in the service of the country, but recently many militarists despatched telegrams to the Government to the effect that they were waiting for orders to mobilize. What can such tactics mean and what did these militarists have in view before they sent these telegrams? Can it be that those militarists who refrained from sending similar telegrams to the Government are not willing to serve the nation? How ridiculously strange is such a national predicament! Are the people not under the control of the Government, law abiding and do they not pay their taxes, etc.? Does this not mean that we support the country? Why then should there be any necessity for such tactics. Such inexplicable political inconsistencies are indeed monstrous in the opinion of the foreigners but we Chinese who have been accustomed to them for over ten **〔此处转录不清〕** cease to pay any attention to them.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

难以解释的政治矛盾。

日本指责中国不是一个有组织的国家，这无疑是对我国的卑鄙侮辱。然而，如果我们仔细阅读报纸，就会发现数量惊人的难以解释的政治矛盾。例如，财政部长希望禁止所有省级当局截留国家财政收入，为此发出通电解禁，却收到几个省级当局的公开支持。让我们问问，这种行政政策意味着什么？

另一个例子：士兵是为国家服务的，但最近许多军阀向政府发电报，称他们正等待动员命令。这种策略意味着什么？这些军阀在发出这些电报之前有什么打算？难道那些没有向政府发送类似电报的军阀就不愿意为国家服务吗？这种国家困境是多么荒谬可笑！人民难道不在政府的控制之下，不守法，不纳税等吗？这难道不意味着我们在支持国家吗？那么为何还有必要使用这种策略。在外国人看来，这种难以解释的政治不一致确实是怪诞的，但我们中国人已经习惯了十多年 **〔此处转录不清〕** 不再关注它们。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
D. 3538.
Date 20 / 4 / 38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Letter from Shanghai No. 1 Special District Court.

No. 4997 April 16, 1938.

S.M.P. Headquarters,
Shanghai.

Sirs,

I have received a letter from the Shanghai Public
Safety Bureau stating that according to a complaint made
by one Tang Chi Ming (陳企明) to the effect that the
criticisms in all the papers in our country have been
against our enemies since the outbreak of hostilities.
It has come to his knowledge that there is one reactionary
publication entitled the "Chung Hua Weekly" (中華週報).
Some of the articles in the 16th issue such as "Mysterious
Policy of Government", "Government asleep", "Reduction of
Salary of National Government" and "Weak Points Disclosed
during the Recent Hostilities", are nothing but reactionary
against the Government and pro-Japanese. Readers were
surprised of its baseless contents. Inasmuch as its
serious nature of influence which may lead our citizens
to think adversely of the Government, it is hoped that
necessary action be taken in order to suppress the same.
The Editor, Ling Hsi Chien (林希謙), was educated in
Japan and is on very intimate terms with the Japanese
community. While our Country is now facing the National
crisis, it is the duty of all the pressmen to supply
righteous articles which will inspire all the citizens
with patriotism, and despite which he should have acted
in the contrary and be pro-Japanese. A copy of the paper
was enclosed for perusal. On the contents of the paper
being perused, it is ascertained that it is a reactionary
publication. Its offices as published thereon is situated

日期 1938年4月20日

上海公共租界工部局警务处
总监办公室。

上海第一特区地方法院来函译文。

1938年4月16日，第4997号。

上海公共租界工部局警务处总部，
上海。

诸位先生，

本人收到上海市公安局来函，内称：据陈企明投诉，自战事爆发以来，我国所有报纸的批评矛头均指向敌人。但他获悉有一份名为《中华周报》的反动刊物。该刊第16期中的一些文章，如“政府之神秘政策”、“政府昏睡”、“国民政府减薪”及“近期战事中暴露之弱点”，无非是反政府及亲日的反动言论。读者对其无稽内容感到惊讶。鉴于其影响严重，可能导致市民对政府产生不利看法，希望采取必要行动予以取缔。该刊编辑林希谦曾在日本受教育，与日本社区关系极为密切。在我国面临民族危机之际，所有新闻工作者均有责任提供激发市民爱国热情的正义文章，而他却反其道而行之，表现亲日。随函附上该报一份供审阅。经审阅该报内容，确认为反动刊物。其所刊登的办事处位于

at No. 19 Jasown Road. Apart from instructions being
given to their staff of the Public Safety Bureau to
suppress the same in the Chinese Territory, they have
brought the matter to my attention by sending me a
copy of the paper and request me to deal with the
case according to law.

In view of the above request, I should feel
oblige if you would be good enough to cause necessary
action to be taken against the said "Chung Hua Weekly"
and kindly favour me with a reply in due course.

Tseu Sien Choh
President.
